name: Hawas Ice
notes: Fragrantica: Aromatic, for men, 2023; 'Cardamon' is Fragrantica's spelling. Rasasi's Saudi store (HAWAS ICE 100 ML, 'FOR HIM') gives essentially the same pyramid plus one extra heart note: Top Frozen Apple, Bergamot Italy, Lemon Italy, Star Anise China; Heart Orange Blossom, Marine Accord Iced, Plum, Cardamom Ceylan; Base 'Crystral Moss', Drift Wood, 'Ambar', Musk. The Amazon.sa listing bullets give a different pyramid that matches neither (Top bergamot, lemon, mint; Heart orange blossom, cardamom, plum, blackcurrant; Base patchouli, amber, tonka, sandalwood); treat the Amazon bullets as unreliable. Gender: Fragrantica and Rasasi's product title say men/For Him, but the Rasasi store's product category field says UNISEX and Amazon.sa's department field says unisex.

name: Supremacy Collector's Edition Pour Homme
notes: Fragrantica: Chypre Fruity, for men, 2024, perfumer Imran Fazlani. Afnan's UAE site (Type Eau De Parfum, 100 ML, Orientation Pour Homme) gives the same notes: Opening Pineapple, Bergamot, Apple, White Floral; Heart Orange Blossom, Birch, Amber; Dry-down Oak Moss, Musk, Ambergris. The Amazon.sa listing (ASIN B07WC5V4QN) gives no note list, only 'Smoky woods and citrus'; its Date First Available is 11 November 2024. A UK retailer titles it 'for Unisex' in search results (not read); Afnan markets it Pour Homme.

name: Najdia
gender: men (as marketed by Lattafa and on Amazon.sa); Fragrantica lists it for women and men
notes: Fragrantica: Aromatic Aquatic, for women and men, 2020. The Amazon.sa listing (ASIN B01N4JN1U1) bullets give the same notes as Fragrantica in a different order, and its A+ text calls it 'Najdia Silver ... Men's Eau de Parfum'. DISAGREEMENT: Lattafa's own product page (Size 100 ML, Fragrance type: Men) lists a different pyramid: Top Grapefruit, 'Mandarian'; Heart Spicy Notes, Rose, Cinnamon; Base Amber, Leather, Patchouli, Woody Notes. The same page's description copies Fragrantica's 'Aromatic Aquatic ... for women and men' sentence and mentions gift-set contents, so the page looks mis-edited, but it is the house's own listing. YEAR DOUBT: Amazon.sa gives Date First Available 9 February 2018, earlier than Fragrantica's 2020. Parfumo's Najdia page showed implausible data (e.g. notes 'Diagonal Sandalwood', 'Hexagonal Frangipani', perfumer David Seth Moltz) and was disregarded. Not to be confused with Najdia Intense (2024), Najdia in Gold, Najdia Tribute or Oud Najdia, which have separate Fragrantica pages.

name: Dynasty
notes: IDENTITY: the Amazon.sa listing 'Lattafa Dynasty EDP Unisex 3.4 Fl Oz' is ASIN B0FK3NXQ8G: byline 'Visit the Lattafa Store', Manufacturer Lattafa, model LD100U, Date First Available 18 August 2025, Fragrance concentration Eau de Parfum. Its bullets give the same pyramid as Fragrantica's Dynasty by Lattafa Perfumes (2025, Woody Spicy, for women and men, perfumer Alex Lee) and as lattafa.com's Dynasty page (Unisex, 100 ML, no sub-brand shown). So the maker is Lattafa's main line, not Lattafa Pride or Maison Alhambra; searches turned up no Dynasty from those houses, but those searches were not exhaustive. RATINGS: on 25 September 2026 the Amazon.sa page showed 1,402 ratings (4.4 stars), not about 14,000; the 14,000 figure may be a misreading of 1,402 or may belong to another listing.

name: Jazal (جزل)
gender: unisex (per a third-party retailer; Nice One's page does not state gender)
notes: Pyramid read from Nice One's product description (Eau De Parfum, 80ml; 'Launched in 2024'; 'Fragrance Family: Oriental, Floral'). Arabic page: المكونات العليا البرغموت، الفلفل الوردي؛ الوسطى العود، العنبر؛ القاعدية جلد الغزال، المسك ('Suede' = جلد الغزال). Nice One's Specifications tab is incomplete (Middle 'Amber - Oud', Base 'Suede' only). A third-party retailer (Moonfume, read through a fetch summary) gives gender 'الجنسين - رجالي - نسائي' and lists the middle as oud only. No Fragrantica page found, so no accords (Fragrantica's 'AROUB' by PEARLA NERA, 2022, is a different perfume). Aroub's own website was not found; searches surfaced only its Instagram and X accounts, and I did not independently confirm that Aroub is a Saudi house. NAME CLASH: Al Sulaiman Oud sells a different 'عطر جزل 80مل' (alsulimanoud.com; notes oud, bergamot, 'Roman musk'); do not merge it with this one.

name: Yara Moi
notes: MAJOR DISAGREEMENT. Fragrantica (for women, 2022): Top Jasmine, Peach; Middle Caramel, Amber; Base Patchouli, Sandalwood. Lattafa's own pages (lattafa.com: Size 100 ML, Fragrance type Women; lattafa-usa.com the same) list a different pyramid: Top Pear, Pink Pepper, Black Currant (spelled 'Black Current'); Middle Tuberose (spelled 'Tubercose'), Jasmine, Almond; Base Vanilla, Cashmeran, Patchouli. Only Jasmine and Patchouli overlap. The house's list is the manufacturer's claim; Fragrantica's is the preferred source under this brief. Decide which to use before publishing. Concentration: lattafa.com does not state it for the 100 ml spray; 'Eau de Parfum' comes from the Amazon.com listing title seen in search results only (lattafa-usa also sells a separate 20 ml pure concentrated perfume oil). Parfumo's Yara Moi page showed implausible note names (e.g. 'Echoed Elemi', 'Backwards Bergamot') and was disregarded.

name: Club de Nuit Woman
notes: IDENTITY: Club de Nuit Woman and Club de Nuit Intense Woman are two different perfumes, and both are sold in 105 ml (3.6 oz), so the size does not tell them apart; the notes do. The Amazon.sa listing 'Armaf Club De Nuit Perfume for Women Eau De Parfum 105ML' (ASIN B00CLF6K3I; model name CLUB DE NUIT; A+ text 'Armaf Club De Nuit Femme', 'Floral Fruity') lists Top Bergamot, Grapefruit, Peach, Orange; Middle Geranium, Jasmine, Litchi, Rose; Base Musk, Patchouli, Vanilla, Vetiver. That matches Fragrantica's Club de Nuit Woman (Floral Fruity) and Armaf's own Club De Nuit Woman page (EDP; 30, 105, 200 ml and other sizes). So the listing is Club de Nuit Woman. For contrast, Club de Nuit Intense Woman (Fragrantica page titled 'Club de Nuit Intense', for women, Chypre Floral; Armaf's page gives the same notes) is Top Rose, Saffron, Geranium; Middle Nutmeg, Pepper, Violet, Caraway; Base Patchouli, Agarwood (Oud), Vanilla, Amber. No launch year on Fragrantica or Armaf. The Amazon.sa page showed 19,230 ratings. Other variants with separate Fragrantica pages (Woman Extrait 2025, Woman Extreme Edition 2025, Woman Perfume Oil 2022, Lionheart Woman 2025) are different products.

name: Raindrops
notes: Fragrantica gives only a generic flat list (Floral Fruity, for women, 2006); it shows exactly six accords. The sources do not agree on a specific pyramid. Ajmal India's official page gives Top Jasmine, Ylang Ylang, Rose; Heart Tonka, Musk, Vanilla; Base Rose, Jasmine (the base repeats top notes, which looks like a data-entry error). Parfumo mirrors that (Top Jasmine, Rose, Ylang-ylang; Heart Musk, Patchouli, Vanilla, Tonka bean; Base Jasmine, Rose). Ajmal's UAE page (Eau De Parfum, Female, 50 ml, 'Launched in 2006') shows unlabelled key notes 'Bergamot, Rose, Musk' and an ingredients strip 'amber, Citrus, jasmine, Rose', and its prose describes a fruity-floral opening with a woodsy and ambergris base. A search-engine summary also quoted a pyramid (Bergamot, Mandarin, Orange, Orange Blossom / Rose, Ylang Ylang, Jasmine / Musk, Amber, Styrax) whose source page I could not identify; it is unverified and not used. Also sold as a perfume oil, which is a separate product.

name: Choco Musk
notes: Fragrantica gives a flat list (Oriental Vanilla, for women and men, no year). Its page does not name a format, but a separate Fragrantica page exists for the spray (Choco Musk Eau de Parfum, 2023: Vanilla, Chocolate, Musk, Spices, Amber, Cinnamon, Sandal, Oriental Woodsy notes, Rose; https://www.fragrantica.com/perfume/Al-Rehab/Choco-Musk-Eau-de-Parfum-88083.html), so 20139 is taken as the oil. A third Fragrantica URL in search results (ALREHAB-PERFUMES/Choco-Musk-122906, '2026') redirected to the Fragrantica home page when opened. The house's store alrehabstore.com ('Choco musk 6 ml, Unisex - Fragrance oil'; the footer gives Al Rehab's commercial registration) gives a pyramid: Top Vanilla, Chocolate; Heart Musk, Spices, Cinnamon; Base Sandalwood, Oriental Woods, Rose. Its prose also names myrrh in the base. alrehab.com (Jeddah) lists a 3 ml oil described as cocoa with white musk, with no pyramid. Retailers sell it mostly as a 6 ml roll-on.

name: Amaali
notes: Fragrantica: Floral Woody Musk, for women, in its Concentrated Perfume Oils collection, no year. Swiss Arabian's UAE site (CPO 15ML; 'Amaali for her is a concentrated perfume oil'; family Woody, Fruity, Gourmand) gives the same notes: Top Pineapple, Lemon, Apple; Middle Jasmine, Rose; Base Cedarwood, Sandal, Musk, Vanilla, Amber, Caramel. Jomashop titles it 'Unisex' in search results (not read); the house markets it for women.

name: Musk Silk
notes: The Fragrantica page read (Musk Silk, Oriental Floral, for women and men, no year) gives a flat list. Its page does not say it is the oil; I take it as the oil because Fragrantica lists the spray separately as Musk Silk Supreme (2022; Top Lily of the Valley; Middle Musk; Base Musk, Amber). DISAGREEMENT: Ajmal's Saudi store page for the oil (MUSK SILK, 12ML French Fragrance Oil, Unisex Attar) lists Top Lily Of The Valley; Heart Musk; Base Musk, Amber. That is identical to Fragrantica's Musk Silk Supreme (spray) pyramid and differs from the oil's Fragrantica list (no Tolu Balsam or Vanilla). Ajmal's UAE page for the oil (Perfume Oil, Unisex, 12/24/60 gm; tags Floral, Musk, Ambery) contradicts itself: one paragraph names lavender and cedarwood in the heart and sandalwood, cedarwood, vetiver and caramel in the base; another names pomegranate, strawberry and peony on top, lily of the valley in the heart and a powdery wood base. For a Saudi catalogue the Saudi store's pyramid is the house's own claim for the exact product sold here. Marked partial because the Fragrantica entry's format is inferred and the house's sources conflict.

name: Musamam White Intense
notes: Fragrantica: Oriental Floral, for women and men, 2023, perfumer Gaël Montero. lattafa-usa.com (page title 'Unisex 100ML Edp Spray') gives exactly the Fragrantica pyramid. lattafa.com (Size 100 ML, Fragrance type Unisex) gives a shorter one: Top Bergamot, Orange, Spices; Heart Ylang, Coconut, Ambroxan; Base Sandalwood, Benzoin (it omits Mahonial and Musk).

name: Oud Malaki
notes: Fragrantica: Woody Spicy, for men, 2012, perfumer Dominique Ropion. Chopard's own page (Men's Fragrances, 80 ML Eau de Parfum) gives no pyramid, but its description names grapefruit, lavender, herbal Artemisia, tobacco and spices with oud, which is consistent with Fragrantica. The same page lists the other Malaki scents (Leather, Rose, Tobacco, Black Incense and Cedar Malaki). A Golden Scent listing is titled 'for women and men' in search results (not read); Chopard markets it for men.
